messages:
elaine: Quick note  we're running an abbreviated all-hands next Thu 10:00am PT titled 'Launch learnings + policy pulse' — ~40m. Outline: 7m exec overview, 12m launch metrics & incident summary, 8m policy update (telemetry + retention defaults), 5m customer highlight, 8m curated Q&A. Please drop any must-cover bullets in-thread by Tue EOD.

marco: Invite is live: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3522223333>. RSVP and indicate if you'll be joining in person (limited seating).

sasha: For the incident segment I'll present a 3-bullet RCA on Sunday's routing hiccup and the mitigation checklist. Will post the 1-pager here Wed AM.

tiffany: Policy heads-up: we'll propose making 60-day telemetry the hosted default with an opt-in for extended retention; Dedicated/Private unaffected unless teams opt in. Draft FAQ in drive: <https://drive.redwood.com/policy/telemetry-change-draft>. Please review and comment by Tue.

ops-bot: Ops note: the failover increased outbound egress cost by ~1.7% during the hour; we'll include the cost slide in the metrics block and link the postmortem after the meeting.

elaine: Accessibility: captions ON; transcript attached after. If you need interpretation/ASL reply here: "interpretation: yes" so we can book.

marco: Presenters: upload slides to the shared deck by Wed 5pm: <https://drive.redwood.com/allhands/launch-pulse-3522>. Keep demos under 60s. If you need presenter rights DM me.

sasha: LIVE question: will the telemetry default change affect customer debugging flows?

tiffany: LIVE answer: no breaking changes; we'll provide a temporary snapshot export for customers during migration and a contact flow for extended retention requests. We'll add the flow to the FAQ slide.

elaine: For Q intake use the thread or the form <https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-qa>. Mark LIVE at the start if you want to ask on-air. We'll triage questions ahead of time.

allhands-bot: Reminder scheduled: 48h and 1h before the event. Recording + transcript will be posted to #all-hands-resources after meeting. :bell:

elaine: Action items: 1) Presenters upload slides Wed 5pm (owners: product/ops/legal). 2) Sasha post the incident one-pager Wed AM. 3) Tiffany finalize policy FAQ Tue EOD. 4) Everyone: drop Qs in-thread or via the form. I'll publish the final agenda Wed evening. Thanks! :rocket:
